note: Completed local Beast run with four concurrent fixture processes after merging #3661 and regenerating the saved state and records through the shipped refresh. These are local body seconds, not hosted times or a p90. Existing estimates outside the split are retained. The two DNS bridge cases were measured again after merging #3666 and regenerating the network boundary from a real refresh; their former main estimates (129s and 6s) are replaced with these local body times.
single_refresh_cases: the saved refreshed fleet boundary matches a real first refresh and start
a refresh whose inputs did not change converges nothing, keeps the fleet running and base as it is, and still waits for readiness
a changed input runs only its due parts: the code with a pending migration migrates and restarts, converges nothing and retakes base of the nested Gateway
the next refresh repeats no part: the code with a pending migration migrates and restarts, converges nothing and retakes base of the nested Gateway
a changed input runs only its due parts: the code without a pending migration migrates and restarts, converges nothing and keeps base
the next refresh repeats no part: the code without a pending migration migrates and restarts, converges nothing and keeps base
a changed input runs only its due parts: a swamp file the base converge reads converges
the next refresh repeats no part: a swamp file the base converge reads converges
a changed input runs only its due parts: the agent contract migrates and restarts
the next refresh repeats no part: the agent contract migrates and restarts
a changed input alone runs its own part, once: the fleet intent converges, and its files retake base
a converge with changed tasks retakes base only for the changed Node and Gateway
a converge without change counts retakes all three bases
a missing base is retaken without another converge
a failed refresh that changed a Node removes its old record and writes none
a refresh after a failed run converges every part and retakes all three bases
a deleted record runs every part and never fails the refresh
a malformed record runs every part and never fails the refresh
an unreadable record runs every part and never fails the refresh
a failed digest read runs every part and never fails the refresh
a moved base intent of one Node converges the three Nodes one by one, and the result names why
a converge older than seven days runs although no input changed, and the result names it stale
an unreadable base intent digest converges, names why, and records no converge digest
a refresh whose migrate applied one retakes base of the nested Gateway alone, and a reset after it comes up on the new schema
a grants reload that changed a file retakes base of the nested Gateway alone, whose disk holds the grants
on a partly stopped fleet the rules only compare: a rule that differs on a running container fails the refresh and writes nothing
an inner bridge without no-resolv passes a start unwritten; the refresh sets it with the fleet stopped and retakes base of all three
a start refuses with instance.container_fleet_drift when the inner bridge cannot be read
